title: Behind the Lens: A Day of Youth Digital Safety Training
excerpt: 700+ young people trained so far. Here's what a full day of digital safety training looks like, the games, the stories, and the moment it clicks.
body:
People imagine safety training as a lecture. It's not. It's a room full of young people discovering, often out loud, that they've already been targets, and learning exactly what to do about it.

The opening question

I always start with one question: "Who here has received a message from a stranger asking for money, codes, or a password?" Hands go up slowly, then all at once. That's the moment the room leans in.

What we actually cover

  • Spotting scam and phishing patterns, the "urgent" tone, the "too good" offer, the fake authority
  • Passwords and two step verification, done practically, on their own phones
  • Privacy checkups: who can really see your posts, your stories, your location
  • Cyberbullying, how to respond, how to report, how to support a friend
  • What to do immediately if an account is compromised

Why it matters to me

Before I was a videographer, I saw friends lose accounts, money and confidence to scammers. Since then I've helped stop 4 international scams, saving over 10M XAF, and recovered 20+ stolen accounts. Training young people before it happens is the better fight.
